correctness.rationale: At integer Zak fiber, Zg=(1+c exp(-idθ))Zh and the two modulation cosets are θ and θ+π. Exact channel sum E=|F+H+|²+|F−H−|² with H±=1−x±x exp(iθ). Even d factors as 2[(1−x)²+x²]|1+c exp(−idθ)|², giving A=(|c|−1)², B=2(|c|+1)². Odd d gives E=2D(1−t)+4|c|t cosθ cos(dθ−arg c), t=2x(1−x)∈[0,1/2]; affine minimization gives A=D+2ρ min product, B=2D. Zero equality requires c=−1; all zero fibers are measure-zero so nonframes stay complete. Orthogonality of distinct trigonometric harmonics makes min negative for odd d≥3; d1 product min=(cosφ−1)/2, so unique 2-condition-number optimum d1 c>0. Nondegenerate maximum expansion at c≈−1 yields u²+v²/(d²+1)+O((|u|+|v|)^3), even quartic imaginary law. Independently sampled exact direct channel energy on dense x/θ grids d=1..5 with positive, negative and complex c, comparing analytic endpoints; grids only corroborate continuum proof.

originality.rationale: Best-of-knowledge PASS for coherent two-pulse filtered generator classification, not for classical Zak transform and single-hat frame criteria. Recent Stangl-Frederick and Hasannasab-Lemvig analyze individual second-order B-splines while varying lattice; Christensen-Kim-Kim use linear combinations as approximate dual windows, not characterize their own sharp coherent-generator spectrum. General two-tap Zak factorization is available background but the parity/nonframe/completeness/conditioning/all-phase result was not seen in the checked source summaries and published indexed records.
